metadata.summary: Nitin called to inquire about the status of his order, but the call ended abruptly without resolving the issue.

messages.text: Hello Nitin, Welcome to Manhattan Bagel. It is great to see you again. How can I help you today?
Yeah. I have a follow-up with my order ID. Could you please help me?
I'd be happy to help you with your order, Nitin. Before we get started, could you please tell me what you would like to order today?
Not an order today. I had problem with my order ID.
Let me check on the status of your order. Can you please tell me your order ID
